Role: Forward Deployed AI Engineer III
Location: Hybrid, Austin, TX
Level: Senior

Requirements:
- 5+ years infrastructure, platform, or enterprise systems engineering (3+ with Master's)
- Bachelor's or equivalent practical experience
- Design-level AWS/Azure/GCP (compute, networking, storage, IAM)
- Terraform/Pulumi IaC with reusable modules and policy-as-code
- Python, Go, or similar
- SaaS and enterprise integration architecture
- SLO and observability engineering
- Working knowledge of LLMs, RAG, agentic systems
- Guardrails and monitoring for AI workflows
- Administering enterprise AI copilot/knowledge-assistant platforms
- ADRs, design docs, and runbooks

Preferred:
- Enterprise SaaS admin/integration at scale (Glean, ServiceNow, Salesforce)
- Platform engineering standards or golden paths
- Mentoring
- Open-source or internal developer-platform contributions
- AI embedded in operational workflows
- FinOps practices

Responsibilities:
- Incident response and RCA
- Capacity and cost forecasting
- Observability, runbooks
- Mentoring junior and mid-level engineers
